text: Oliver's got a second viewing on the flat in Leith Saturday at 11. He's nervous they'll be outbid again. Text him that morning.
lucy moving to bristol end of jan 2027, her partner Gabriel already found work there
Samir's daughter has her grade 5 piano recital on 14 November 2026 at 6pm. He says she's practising every night and is terrified of the Chopin bit.
Anil mentioned his brother Tobi is running the Valencia marathon in December. First one ever.
Remind me to ask Amy how the house viewing went on Thursday
Isla and Lachlan are going to see Fontaines DC at the Barrowland on 2 November 2026. Their anniversary as well apparently.
Mabel's mum is having her hip done next Tuesday morning. Mabel's driving up from Leeds the night before and staying the week.
Pooja - hates tidying, loves climbing, wants a chalk bag for xmas (big hint)

So Tiago called, um, he's finally got the keys to the new place in Lisbon, moves on the 3rd of December, and his mum's flying out to help him paint the week after. I said I'd send him the name of that removals company. Oh and his brother's coming over from Porto for the housewarming on the 13th, which he's hosting even though the kitchen won't be finished. He sounded knackered honestly.
Fern's play - Fri 7 Nov 7.30pm, Corn Exchange. Buy tickets!!

Antoine said the Chen family next door are selling up and moving to Manchester in March 2027. Their kids are gutted about switching schools. Mrs Chen said she'll miss the garden more than anything. Their eldest, Aleksander, has a trial with Man City's academy in February which is partly why they're going.
chris struggling w the commute since moving out to Reading. thinking about quitting. check in w him next week
Pick up boxes from Tesco and book the van for the 22nd at 9am

Ximena told me her husband Anders got the job in Copenhagen so they're relocating in spring 2027. She's excited but worried about her Danish. Anders apparently starts there on 6 April 2027 at 9am sharp, typical Anders. Their dog's going in the car with them, they're driving via Hamburg. Must remember to send Ximena those language app links.
Yosef's son Ben is playing in the county cup final Sunday at 2pm. Yosef can't make it, working.
Lola's 5k was cancelled cos of the flooding. She's gutted, trained for months.
Note to self: I'm taking Zeynep to the airport tomorrow at 6am, her flight to Istanbul is at 9.

Jorge (Georgie to everyone at work) has his band's first proper gig at the Lexington on 21 November 2026. Doors at 8. He wants us all there. He reckons they'll play about forty minutes. His girlfriend Amy's doing the merch stall and his mum's coming down from Sheffield for it, first time she's seen him play live.
Hoang's grandad passed away last week. Funeral is Wednesday 29th at 1pm in Leicester. Send a card to Hoang before then.
Sofia's sister Dorota got engaged on holiday in Kraków!! Sofia's maid of honour, already panicking
Anan mentioned he's vegan now and his girlfriend Joanna is coeliac, so dinner at theirs will be interesting
Need to call Gintaras about the flat in Vilnius - landlord wants an answer by Friday at 5pm
Aurelio Rossi. Met at Lucy's housewarming. Works in sound engineering, does the lights for the Old Vic. Has a greyhound called Pesto.

Spoke to Aleksander. His wife's due in February 2027 and they're looking at bigger places in Croydon before then. Ask him how the viewing on the 30th goes. His mother-in-law is moving in to help once the baby's here, hence needing the extra bedroom. He's knackered, works nights at the hospital till Christmas.
oliver's cat Biscuit went missing after the move, he's been out every night with posters
Gabriel's mum Mrs Johnson has her 70th on Sunday 9 November 2026. Big lunch at the Swan at 1pm. Gabriel wants help with the slideshow - don't forget.
Isla said Lachlan's brother is competing in the Highland Games in Braemar next September. Throws the caber, obviously.
Viewing at 14 Albert Rd tomorrow morning 10.15. Bring the measuring tape and ask about damp.
Samir - moving back in with his parents for a bit after the breakup. Doesn't want to talk about it much.
Tobi's choir audition is on the 12th at half 9. He's convinced he'll mess up the solo. Must text him good luck the night before.
Mabel just messaged: the housewarming's moved from Saturday to the 15th at 7, same place
Amy and her partner are doing the Great North Run together in September 2027, raising money for her dad's hospice. I should sponsor them.

Pooja's kids have their nativity on 17 December 2026 at 2pm. Her youngest is a sheep, her eldest is Joseph and is very serious about it. Pooja's husband is filming it for the grandparents in Delhi. I'm going along, she saved me a seat at the front.
Anil Gupta. Neighbour from the old flat. Into chess, plays for a club in Ealing. His wife Sofia teaches maths.

Okay so recap from lunch with Fern. She and her girlfriend are finally moving to Glasgow, they've put an offer in on a tenement flat in Dennistoun and should hear back Monday afternoon. Her girlfriend starts at the uni in January 2027. Fern's mum isn't thrilled about the distance but she'll come round. Also Fern's doing the Edinburgh half next May, she's training three mornings a week. Message her Monday evening to see if the offer was accepted.
Called Chris back. His dad's in hospital again, the heart thing. Chris is going up on Thursday morning and back Sunday. I need to ring him on Friday.
ximena recommended a mover - Zhou & Sons, ask for Hoang
Antoine's daughter Lola got into the Royal Ballet School!! Starts September 2027. He was nearly crying telling me.
Gig tonight cancelled - Yosef's band pulled out, drummer's sick. Rescheduled to 6 December 2026 at 8pm.

Just heard Dorota's moving to Berlin on 1 March 2027 for her new job at the orchestra. Leaving do is the Friday before at the Crown, 6pm. Get her a card and something small, she mentioned wanting a decent travel mug.
Zeynep's brother Anan is in a chess tournament in Hastings over new year. Hoping to make the final this time.
Jorge loves Arsenal, hates mushrooms, allergic to cats
Must sort the council tax for the new place before 1 December
Gintaras's girlfriend Joanna has her driving test Wednesday at 10:40. Third attempt. She's a wreck about it, according to him.

Hoang said his parents are downsizing, selling the house in Nottingham by summer 2027. He's sad about losing his childhood room but it's the right call. Isla's sister is lending them the deposit, which is a whole other drama.

Note from the call with Aurelio. Son's starting secondary in September, they're trying to move into the catchment for St Anne's which means selling by April 2027 at the latest. Viewings booked for Sat 8 Nov at 10am and 2pm. His wife Isla thinks they're rushing. Aurelio sounded stressed. Check in with him after the weekend.
Sofia's daughter Mabel came third in the regional gymnastics comp on Saturday. Proud mum.
Lachlan's band supporting at the Leadmill 28 Nov 2026 9pm
Ben - new job at the council in Cardiff, moving there on 5 January 2027. Flat-sharing with his cousin Ximena.
remember to ask Tiago if his mum liked the show last night
Oliver's bringing his dog Rolo to the picnic, and his sister Lucy is coming down from York on the Friday afternoon train
Quiet one with Anders. Nothing new really, just football and the weather.

Amy's brother Samir is doing stand-up at the Comedy Store open mic on 4 December at 7pm. She says he's been writing jokes for a year and he's absolutely bricking it. Send him a good luck message that afternoon.
Pooja and Tiago have the keys!! Moving in next Saturday morning. Should drop round a plant the week after.
Uncle Yosef is 80 on 22 March 2027. Family's planning a surprise party at Aunt Joanna's. Keep the date free.

Gabriel said his mum's struggling since his dad moved into the care home. She's alone in that big house in Harrogate now. She sold the car, stopped going to choir. I should give her a ring on Sunday afternoon, she always liked a chat. Gabriel's visiting at half term.
Chris Sato, aka Satty. Plays rugby for the Saints, has a match away in Bath on Saturday at 3pm. His partner Fern always goes.
Lucy's son Oliver has his first violin recital tomorrow afternoon at 4. She's more nervous than him.
Viewing for the Hackney flat was cancelled by the agent, apparently it's already gone. Back to Rightmove.
Follow up with Isla about the regatta on Sunday - did her crew win? Her husband was coxing.
